title: CrashLoopBackOff
symptoms: Pod repeatedly starts and crashes; status shows CrashLoopBackOff.
fix_steps: kubectl logs <pod> --previous
kubectl describe pod <pod> and check Events
Verify ConfigMap/Secret and env vars
Check liveness/readiness probe settings

title: ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull
symptoms: Pod stuck in ImagePullBackOff; image cannot be pulled.
fix_steps: Verify image name and tag exist in the registry
Create and reference an imagePullSecret
kubectl describe pod <pod> for the exact pull error
Test docker pull from a node

title: OOMKilled
symptoms: Container terminated with reason OOMKilled, exit code 137.
fix_steps: Raise resources.limits.memory
Profile the app for leaks
Check kubectl top pod for usage
Add HPA if load-driven

title: Pod Pending / Unschedulable
symptoms: Pod stays Pending; scheduler reports no suitable node.
fix_steps: kubectl describe pod <pod> and read the scheduling event
Reduce resource requests or add nodes
Check taints, tolerations and nodeSelector
Check PVC status

title: Port already in use
symptoms: Container or app fails to start because the port is taken.
causes: Another container or process is using the port
fix_steps: Find the process: lsof -i :<port> or docker ps
Stop the conflicting container/process
Map to a different host port

title: Docker build: package or file not found
symptoms: docker build fails at a COPY or RUN step.
fix_steps: Check paths relative to the build context
Review .dockerignore
Run the failing RUN command manually in a container
Read the exit code and preceding lines

title: Dependency conflict (ERESOLVE)
symptoms: npm install fails with a dependency resolution error.
fix_steps: Read which packages conflict
Align versions in package.json
Regenerate lockfile
As a last resort use --legacy-peer-deps

title: Node heap out of memory during build
symptoms: Build process crashes with a heap limit error.
causes: Large bundle/build exceeding default Node memory
fix_steps: Set NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
Use a larger CI runner
Reduce build parallelism

title: Maven compilation or dependency failure
symptoms: mvn build fails at compile or dependency resolution.
fix_steps: Read the first ERROR line, not the last
Check JDK version vs. maven.compiler settings
Verify repository URL and credentials in settings.xml
Run mvn -U clean install

title: Database connection refused
symptoms: App cannot connect to the database on startup.
causes: DB not running or not ready
Wrong service name in container network
fix_steps: Check the DB service is up and healthy
Verify host, port and credentials in config
Test connectivity from the app container
Add a startup wait or retry

title: Authentication failed
symptoms: DB rejects the app's credentials.
causes: Secret not injected into the environment
fix_steps: Verify the secret value in the deployment environment
Confirm the user and grants on the DB
Check for a stale secret version

title: Permission denied in pipeline
symptoms: Pipeline step fails with a permission error.
fix_steps: chmod +x on the script
Check the token/role scopes
Verify the service account permissions

title: Pipeline timeout
symptoms: Job canceled after exceeding the time limit.
fix_steps: Find the last step that produced output
Add caching for dependencies
Increase the timeout if legitimate

title: Readiness probe failing
symptoms: Pod runs but never becomes Ready; endpoints not added to service.
causes: App not listening on the probe port/path yet
App slow to start, initialDelaySeconds too low
fix_steps: kubectl describe pod <pod> and check probe failure reason
Verify probe path/port match the app
Increase initialDelaySeconds or add a startupProbe

title: PVC stuck Pending
patterns: waiting for a volume to be created
symptoms: PersistentVolumeClaim stays Pending, pod can't start.
causes: No StorageClass or default StorageClass missing
fix_steps: kubectl get storageclass
kubectl describe pvc <name> for events
Check the provisioner/CSI driver pods are healthy

title: ConfigMap/Secret not found
symptoms: Pod fails to start with CreateContainerConfigError.
causes: ConfigMap/Secret not created or wrong name
fix_steps: kubectl get configmap,secret -n <namespace>
Check the name/namespace referenced in the pod spec
Recreate the missing resource

title: Service has no endpoints
symptoms: Service exists but traffic doesn't reach any pod.
causes: Label selector mismatch between Service and pods
fix_steps: kubectl get endpoints <svc>
Compare Service selector to pod labels
Verify targetPort matches the container port

title: Helm upgrade failed / stuck release
symptoms: helm upgrade fails or release is stuck in pending state.
causes: CRD changes not supported by upgrade
fix_steps: helm status <release>
helm rollback <release> <revision>
helm history <release> to find the last good revision

title: Container exits immediately (exit 0/1)
symptoms: Container starts then exits right away.
causes: Entrypoint process finishes and container has no long-running process
Wrong architecture (e.g. arm64 vs amd64) image
fix_steps: docker logs <container>
Check Dockerfile CMD/ENTRYPOINT
Verify image architecture matches the host

title: No space left on device
symptoms: Build or run fails due to disk space.
fix_steps: docker system df
docker system prune -a --volumes
Remove unused images/volumes

title: Cannot connect to Docker daemon
patterns: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
symptoms: docker commands fail immediately.
causes: User lacks permission on docker socket
fix_steps: sudo systemctl start docker
Add user to the docker group (or use sudo)
Check DOCKER_HOST env var

title: Network conflict / bridge issue
patterns: pool overlaps with other one on this address space
symptoms: Container networking fails to create or connect.
causes: Docker network subnet overlaps an existing one
fix_steps: docker network ls / docker network prune
Recreate the network with a non-overlapping subnet
Restart the docker daemon

title: Module not found
symptoms: App crashes on require/import of a missing module.
causes: Dependency not installed or missing from package.json
node_modules not installed in the deploy environment
fix_steps: npm install the missing package and commit the lockfile
Check the import path and file casing
Ensure the build step runs npm ci before start

title: Engine/Node version mismatch
symptoms: npm install or start fails due to Node version.
causes: package.json engines field stricter than the runtime
CI/deploy platform using an old Node version
fix_steps: Set the correct Node version in the platform config (e.g. .nvmrc, engines field)
Align the CI/deploy Node version with local dev

title: Env var undefined at runtime
symptoms: App crashes because an expected env var is missing.
causes: Env var not set in the deployment platform
fix_steps: List required env vars in the platform's settings
Verify the exact variable name matches the code
Add a startup check that fails fast with a clear message

title: OutOfMemoryError during build/test
symptoms: Build or test run crashes with a Java heap error.
causes: Default JVM heap too small for the build
fix_steps: Set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx2g (or higher)
Increase CI runner memory
Profile failing tests for leaks

title: Dependency version conflict
symptoms: Build fails or runtime NoSuchMethodError from conflicting library versions.
causes: Two dependencies pull different versions of the same library
fix_steps: mvn dependency:tree to find the conflict
Add a <dependencyManagement> entry to pin the version
Exclude the transitive dependency causing the conflict

title: Test failures blocking build
symptoms: mvn build fails because unit tests fail.
fix_steps: Read the specific failing test's stack trace
Reproduce locally with mvn test -Dtest=<TestName>
Fix the regression or mark the flaky test for review (don't silently skip)

title: Workflow: missing secret/env
patterns: is not defined in this context
symptoms: Workflow step fails referencing a secret or variable.
causes: Secret not configured in the repo/org settings
Secret not available to forked-PR workflows
fix_steps: Check Settings > Secrets and variables
Verify the exact name used in ${{ secrets.NAME }}
For forks, use pull_request_target carefully or avoid secret-dependent steps

title: Action fails: cache restore/save error
patterns: Cache not found for input keys
symptoms: actions/cache step fails or misses.
causes: Cache key changed (lockfile hash) so no match
Concurrent writes to the same cache key
fix_steps: Confirm the cache key includes a hash of the lockfile
Check the repository's cache usage/limits
Add restore-keys as a fallback

title: Self-hosted/hosted runner out of disk
symptoms: Job fails partway through with a disk space error.
causes: Large build artifacts or Docker layers filling the runner
fix_steps: Add a cleanup step (docker system prune, remove old artifacts)
Use a larger runner
For self-hosted, add cleanup automation between jobs

title: Pipeline: agent offline / no executors
symptoms: Build queued indefinitely, no executor picks it up.
causes: No online agent matching the required label
fix_steps: Check Manage Jenkins > Nodes for agent status
Verify the agent label matches the pipeline's agent{} spec
Restart/reconnect the offline agent

title: Pipeline script security / groovy sandbox error
symptoms: Pipeline fails due to a Groovy sandbox restriction.
causes: Jenkinsfile uses a method not approved in Script Security
fix_steps: Manage Jenkins > In-process Script Approval and approve the signature
Refactor the Jenkinsfile to avoid the restricted call
Use a shared library function instead

title: Credentials not found in pipeline
symptoms: Pipeline fails referencing a credentials ID.
causes: Credentials scoped to a different folder/domain
fix_steps: Manage Jenkins > Credentials and confirm the ID and scope
Match the ID exactly in withCredentials([...])
Recreate the credential if missing

title: Too many connections
symptoms: New DB connections rejected under load.
causes: Connection pool not closing connections properly
max_connections limit too low for concurrent load
fix_steps: Check for unclosed connections/leaked pool clients
Increase max_connections if the DB tier allows it
Add/verify a proper connection pool (e.g. pgbouncer)

title: Migration failed / schema out of sync
symptoms: App errors referencing a missing table/column after deploy.
causes: Migration not run before app deploy
Migration failed partway and wasn't rolled back
Deploy order: app deployed before migration completed
fix_steps: Check migration run logs/status
Run migrations manually against the target DB
Fix the deploy pipeline to run migrations before app rollout

title: Deadlock detected
symptoms: Transaction fails due to a deadlock or lock timeout.
causes: Two transactions acquiring locks in different order
High write contention on the same rows
fix_steps: Review the queries/order of operations in the failing transaction
Add retry logic for deadlock errors
Shorten transaction scope / add appropriate indexes

title: DNS resolution failure
symptoms: App can't resolve a hostname.
fix_steps: Verify the hostname in config/env vars
nslookup/dig the hostname from the same environment
Check network policies/egress rules

title: TLS/SSL certificate error
patterns: unable to verify the first certificate
symptoms: HTTPS calls fail with a certificate error.
causes: Self-signed cert not trusted by the client
fix_steps: Check certificate expiry (openssl s_client)
Renew or reissue the certificate
Ensure the full chain (including intermediates) is served

title: Rate limited by upstream API
symptoms: Calls to an external API start failing with 429.
fix_steps: Add exponential backoff and retry on 429
Check the API's rate limit headers/docs
Cache repeated calls where possible

title: Health check failing at load balancer
symptoms: Load balancer marks the target unhealthy; 502/504 to users.
causes: App not responding on the health check path in time
fix_steps: Verify the health check path/port/timeout settings
Check app logs around the time of failures
Confirm network rules allow the LB to reach the target

title: Disk full on host
symptoms: Writes fail anywhere on the host/app.
causes: Logs or temp files filling the disk
Old build artifacts not cleaned up
fix_steps: df -h to find the full volume
Clean up logs/temp files, add log rotation
Increase disk size if usage is legitimately growing

title: Config file missing or malformed
symptoms: App fails to start while parsing its config file.
causes: Config file not present in the deploy artifact
Syntax error (YAML/JSON) after a manual edit
Wrong config path expected by the app
fix_steps: Confirm the config file is included in the build/deploy artifact
Validate YAML/JSON syntax
Check the path the app expects vs. where the file is placed
